short_description: Nimbus — a mobile-first marketplace's conversion-slide-and-feature-velocity rescue. A checkout-flow change landing unevenly across platforms pushed a cluster of user segments into a conversion slide, faster than the analytical event data could surface to the product. A growth app reads governed cohort data at low latency, a recommendation ranks the feature to ship next (ship a proven variant / ship an alternative / roll out an existing flag) per sliding segment, and a PM approves — writing the decision back to Lakebase for the product to read at low latency (scale-to-zero for near-zero idle cost), with the assistant's AI spend capped against margin.
